name: 31722-longdecode-qwen3next80b-4gpu
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, expert parallelism ON, one in-process vLLM engine. No router, no external cache tier, no KV connector.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1024, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 3072 requests with a 3600 s safety cap. Seed static 31722.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, 32 prompt tokens in and exactly 1000 tokens out per request (min == max on both ends), single turn, text only, generation never stopped early.
purpose: A long-form story generator writing thousand-token completions from brief prompts for 1024 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# The model and topology this setup serves, in the form `vllm serve --config` takes.
# Anything not named here is left at this engine's own defaults.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 4
enable-expert-parallel: true
async-scheduling: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
# LOAD-BEARING: the default at this commit is `min(max_num_seqs * 2, 512)`, so a decode batch of
# 1024 would fall off the end of the captured range and run eager.
max-cudagraph-capture-size: 2048
# Pinned rather than defaulted: a default that resolves below 1024 caps the running batch and
# leaves the rest of the declared streams queued.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-model-len: 2048
